starterCode:
# 杠杆平衡：F1 x L1 = F2 x L2
f1 = 2   # 动力（牛顿）
l1 = 3   # 动力臂（格）
f2 = 3   # 阻力
l2 = 2   # 阻力臂

say("左边力矩 = " + f1 * l1)
say("右边力矩 = " + f2 * l2)
if f1 * l1 == f2 * l2:
    say("力矩相等，杠杆平衡！")
else:
    say("不平衡！要调整力或力臂")

lab.code:
# 杠杆平衡探索台：左力矩 = 右力矩？
L1 = 2   # 左力臂（米）
m1 = 5   # 左边物重（千克）

hide()
torqueL = L1 * m1
torqueR = 2 * 5
dip = torqueL - torqueR
leftY = 0 - dip * 3
rightY = 0 + dip * 3
if leftY < -70:
    leftY = -70
if leftY > 70:
    leftY = 70
if rightY < -70:
    rightY = -70
if rightY > 70:
    rightY = 70
pen_color("red")
pen_down()
go_to(-150, leftY)
go_to(150, rightY)
pen_up()
write("下沉！左力矩 " + torqueL + " > 右力矩 10", 90, 130, "orange", 13)
if torqueL == torqueR:
    write("平衡！两边力矩都是 " + torqueL, 90, 130, "green", 14)
if torqueL < torqueR:
    write("右边沉：左力矩 " + torqueL + " < 10", 90, 130, "blue", 13)
write("左边：" + L1 + "m × " + m1 + "kg", -170, -60 + leftY * 0.4, "red", 11)
write("右边：2m × 5kg（固定）", 60, -60 + rightY * 0.4, "red", 11)
write("△ 支点", -20, 20, "red", 12)
